example_zh: 男孩違抗了父親的命令。

example_zh: 我們需要在明天早上之前得到明確的答案。

example_zh: 機械師檢查了汽車發動機，以找出噪音的原因。

example_zh: 軟體工程師修復了程式中的漏洞。

example_zh: 他選擇在大學學習電機工程。

example_zh: 經常練習可以提高你的語言技能。

example_zh: 讀書給她帶來了極大的樂趣。

example_zh: 我們在海邊度過了一個非常愉快的週末。

example_zh: 他們計劃擴大業務規模。

example_zh: 這次講座讓我對現代哲學有了極大的啟發。

example_zh: 這個項目需要耗費大量的時間和金錢。

example_zh: 我們有足夠的椅子招待所有客人嗎？

example_zh: 文化交流計畫豐富了學生的學習體驗。

example_zh: 過去三年，學校入學人數穩定成長。

example_zh: 離開前請務必鎖好所有門。

example_zh: 你需要門禁卡才能進入大樓。

example_zh: 創辦新企業是一項高風險的活動。

example_zh: 這座城市提供豐富多彩的藝術和娛樂活動。

example_zh: 他對新工作表現出極大的熱情。

example_zh: 觀眾對這位歌手報以熱烈的掌聲。

example_zh: 她花了一整天時間打掃房子。

example_zh: 會員資格可讓您享有所有商品的折扣。

example_zh: 公司部門作為獨立的法律實體運作。

example_zh: 博物館正門位於第三街。

example_zh: 這位年輕的創業家成功創辦了一家科技新創公司。

example_zh: 她每天晚上都會在日記裡寫一篇新的內容。

example_zh: 他把信封好，放進信封裡。

example_zh: 很多人都羨慕她迅速晉升。

example_zh: 我們應該共同努力保護環境。

example_zh: 氣候變遷是當今一個重大的環境議題。

example_zh: 我設想的未來是，再生能源為每個家庭提供電力。

example_zh: 他驚人的才華令同儕羨慕不已。

example_zh: 衛生部門採取緊急措施控制流感疫情。

example_zh: 你看了那部電視劇的最新一集嗎？

example_zh: 所有公民都應享有法律面前人人平等的權利。

example_zh: 她們不懈地爭取職場性別平等。

example_zh: 比賽接近結束時，球隊攻入一球，將比數扳平。

example: You cannot simply equate high income with personal happiness.
example_zh: 你不能簡單地將高收入與個人幸福劃等。

example_zh: 數學老師在黑板上寫下了一個複雜的數學方程式。

example_zh: 健身房配備了現代化的健身器材。

example_zh: 公司提供高階員工股票選擇權。

example_zh: 十美元大約相當於八歐元。

example_zh: 互聯網的發明標誌著一個新時代的開始。

example_zh: 他用濕布擦掉了白板上的痕跡。

example: May I borrow your eraser to fix a mistake in my drawing?
example_zh: 我可以藉用你的橡皮擦來修改我畫上的錯誤嗎？

example: Workers are planning to erect a monument in memory of the heroes.
example_zh: 工人們計劃建造一座紀念碑，以紀念這些英雄。

example: She went out to run a few errands, such as buying groceries.
example_zh: 她出門辦了些事，例如買菜。

example_zh: 系統因技術故障崩潰。

example_zh: 官員警告說，火山隨時可能爆發。

example_zh: 我們搭扶梯上了商場的三樓。

example_zh: 囚犯們趁夜逃脫了。

example: Security guards will escort the VIPs safely to their cars.
example_zh: 保全人員將護送貴賓安全抵達他們的車輛。

example: It is especially important to drink plenty of water during hot weather.
example_zh: 天氣炎熱時，尤其要多喝水。

example: Students were asked to write an essay on environmental protection.
example_zh: 學生被要求寫一篇關於環境保護的文章。

example: Trust and respect are the essence of a healthy relationship.
example_zh: 信任和尊重是健康關係的基礎。

example: Good communication is essential for effective teamwork.
example_zh: 良好的溝通是有效團隊合作的關鍵。

example: The establishment of the new clinic improved local healthcare.
example_zh: 新診所的建立改善了當地的醫療保健狀況。

example: He left his entire real estate portfolio to his children.
example_zh: 他把所有房地產資產都留給了子女。

example: She is held in high esteem by her colleagues for her expertise.
example_zh: 她憑藉著專業技能，深受同事們的尊敬。

example: Experts estimate that the repair work will cost around five thousand dollars.
example_zh: 專家估計，維修費用約為五千美元。

example: She promised her eternal love to him.
example_zh: 她向他許下了永恆的愛。

example: They seemed to wait for an eternity.
example_zh: 他們似乎等了很久很久。

example: The company adheres to a strict code of ethics.
example_zh: 公司恪守嚴格的道德準則。

example: It is not ethical to reproduce copyrighted material without permission.
example_zh: 未經許可複製受版權保護的資料是不道德的。

example: The city has a diverse population with many ethnic groups.
example_zh: 這座城市人口組成多元化，包含許多不同的民族群體。

example: Residents were ordered to evacuate the area before the hurricane.
example_zh: 颶風來臨前，居民被命令撤離該地區。

example: Teachers use tests to evaluate student progress.
example_zh: 教師透過考試來評估學生的學習進度。

example: The manager completed a performance evaluation for each employee.
example_zh: 經理對每位員工都進行了績效評估。

example: On the eve of the election, the candidate's speech drew huge crowds.
example_zh: 選舉前夕，這位候選人的演講吸引了大量人群。

example: He couldn't even stand up after the long run.
example_zh: 長跑之後，他甚至都站不起來了。

example: We enjoyed a peaceful evening at home.
example_zh: 我們在家裡度過了一個寧靜的夜晚。

example: The annual music festival is a major local event.
example_zh: 一年一度的音樂節是當地的重要盛事。

example: The eventual outcome of the negotiations is still uncertain.
example_zh: 談判的最終結果仍不明朗。

example: Have you ever visited Japan?
example_zh: 你曾經去過日本嗎？

example: Pine trees are evergreen and stay green all year round.
example_zh: 松樹是常綠樹，一年四季都保持綠色。

example: Every student must submit the homework by Friday.
example_zh: 所有學生必須在周五之前提交作業。

example: Everyone was excited about the upcoming vacation.
example_zh: 大家都對即將到來的假期感到興奮。

example: She did everything she could to help her friend.
example_zh: 她盡一切努力幫助她的朋友。

example_zh: 警方在犯罪現場發現了關鍵證據。

example: It was evident that he was telling the truth.
example_zh: 很明顯，他說的都是實話。

example: The movie depicts a classic struggle between good and evil.
example_zh: 這部電影描繪了一場經典的善惡鬥爭。

example: The old photograph evoked fond memories of her childhood.
example_zh: 這張老照片喚起了她美好的童年回憶。

example: Darwin's theory of evolution changed our understanding of life.
example_zh: 達爾文的進化論改變了我們對生命的理解。

example: The small start-up company evolved into a global enterprise.
example_zh: 這家小型新創公司發展成為全球性企業。

example_zh: 請問會議的具體時間是什麼時候？

example: Don't exaggerate the problem; it is not that severe.
example_zh: 不要誇大問題，它並沒有那麼嚴重。

example: To say he is the best player in the world is an exaggeration.
example_zh: 說他是世界上最好的球員有點誇張了。

example: She passed her final examination with high marks.
example_zh: 她以優異的成績通過了期末考。

example: The doctor will examine the patient's knee.
example_zh: 醫生將檢查患者的膝蓋。

example: The examinee double-checked her answers before submitting the test.
example_zh: 考生在提交試卷前仔細核對了答案。

example: The driving examiner asked him to park the car.
example_zh: 駕駛考官要求他停車。

example: This article provides a good example of sustainable design.
example_zh: 本文提供了永續設計的一個很好的例子。

example: Drivers should not exceed the speed limit.
example_zh: 駕駛員不應超過限速。

example: She excels in mathematics and science.
example_zh: 她在數學和科學方面都很優秀。

example: The school is renowned for its academic excellence.
example_zh: 這所學校以其卓越的學術成就而聞名。

example: He did an excellent job on the presentation.
example_zh: 他的演講非常出色。

example: Everyone attended the meeting except John.
example_zh: 除了約翰以外，所有人都參加了會議。

example: There is an exception to every rule.
example_zh: 凡事皆有例外。

example_zh: 她從小就展現出非凡的音樂天賦。

example_zh: 該雜誌刊登了這部新小說的節錄。

example_zh: 飲食中攝取過多的糖分會導致健康問題。

example_zh: 過量飲酒會損害肝臟。

example_zh: 他們會面交流關於新專案的想法。

example_zh: 這則消息在粉絲中引起了極大的興奮。

example: The children were excited about going to the zoo.
example_zh: 孩子們對去動物園感到興奮不已。

example: It was an exciting match between the two top teams.
example_zh: 這是兩支頂級球隊之間的一場激動人心的比賽。

example_zh: 「今天天氣真好！」她驚嘆道。

example: The price excludes taxes and delivery fees.
example_zh: 價格不含稅金和運費。

example: The exclusion of women from the club sparked controversy.
example_zh: 俱樂部將女性排除在外的做法引發了爭議。

example_zh: 該報獲得了對總統的獨家專訪。

example_zh: 請原諒我遲到了。

example_zh: 團隊完美地執行了專案計劃。

example: The successful execution of the strategy led to record profits.
example_zh: 該策略的成功實施帶來了創紀錄的利潤。

example: The chief executive officer made the final decision.
example_zh: 首席執行官做出了最終決定。

example_zh: 慈善機構通常免繳所得稅。

example_zh: 規律運動有益健康。

example_zh: 他費了九牛二虎之力才把這個沉重的箱子搬起來。

example_zh: 漫長的健行讓旅行者們筋疲力盡。

example_zh: 博物館將展出古埃及文物。

example_zh: 我們週末去參觀了一個藝術展覽。

example_zh: 這位政治領袖流亡了十年。

example_zh: 恐龍已在地球上滅絕。

example_zh: 科學家正在研究火星上是否有生命存在。

example_zh: 緊急情況請使用側門。

example_zh: 他們喜歡從熱帶雨林採集稀有植物。

example: The company plans to expand its business into Asia.
example_zh: 該公司計劃將業務拓展到亞洲。

example_zh: 城市快速擴張導致了交通問題。

example_zh: 這次活動超出了我們所有人的預期。

example_zh: 團隊組織了一次登山探險。

example: The government announced a reduction in public expenditure.
example_zh: 政府宣布削減公共開支。

example: Travel expenses will be covered by the company.
example_zh: 差旅費用將由公司負擔。

example_zh: 購買新房子可能非常昂貴。

example: She has years of experience in marketing.
example_zh: 她擁有多年的行銷經驗。

example: Scientists are conducting an experiment to test the new drug.
example_zh: 科學家正在進行一項實驗來測試這種新藥。

example: The medical team tried an experimental treatment on the patient.
example_zh: 醫療團隊對患者進行了實驗性治療。

example_zh: 她是氣候變遷領域的權威專家。

example: We need someone with technical expertise to solve this problem.
example_zh: 我們需要一位具備技術專長的人員來解決這個問題。

example: Check the expiration date on the milk carton before drinking it.
example_zh: 飲用牛奶前，請先查看牛奶盒上的保存期限。

example: My passport will expire in three months.
example_zh: 我的護照還有三個月就過期了。

example_zh: 你能解釋一下這台機器的工作原理嗎？

example: He offered a detailed explanation for his absence.
example_zh: 他詳細解釋了自己缺席的原因。

example: The instructions were very explicit and easy to follow.
example_zh: 說明書非常清晰易懂。

example_zh: 炸彈在軍事基地附近爆炸。

example_zh: 有些公司剝削發展中國家的廉價勞工。

example_zh: 太空探索帶來了許多技術進步。

example_zh: 他們去探索了那座古老的洞穴。

example_zh: 全城都聽到了一聲巨響。

example_zh: 炸藥是一種極易爆炸的材料。

example_zh: 台灣向世界各國出口電子產品。

example: Do not expose your skin to direct sunlight for too long.
example_zh: 不要讓皮膚長時間暴露在陽光直射下。

example: Prolonged exposure to cold weather can cause frostbite.
example_zh: 長時間暴露在寒冷天氣中會導致凍傷。

example: She found it hard to express her feelings.
example_zh: 她發現自己很難表達自己的感受。

example: His facial expression showed that he was angry.
example_zh: 他臉上的表情顯示他很生氣。

example_zh: 她那雙會說話的眼睛傳遞出她的熱情。

example: The deadline has been extended to next Monday.
example_zh: 截止日期已延長至下週一。

example: Can you give me your phone extension number?
example_zh: 請問您的電話分機號碼是多少？

example_zh: 這場風暴對森林造成了廣泛的破壞。

example: To some extent, I agree with your opinion.
example_zh: 某種程度上，我同意你的觀點。

example: The exterior of the building was newly painted.
example_zh: 建築物的外牆重新粉刷過了。

example: The company decided to hire an external consultant.
example_zh: 公司決定聘請外部顧問。

example: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
example_zh: 恐龍在數百萬年前就滅絕了。

example: She works extra hours to earn more money.
example_zh: 她加班加點以賺取更多收入。

example: They managed to extract useful data from the server.
example_zh: 他們成功地從伺服器中提取出了有用的數據。

example: She participates in several extracurricular activities after school.
example_zh: 放學後，她參加了許多課外活動。

example: She has an extraordinary talent for playing the piano.
example_zh: 她擁有非凡的鋼琴演奏天賦。

example: The weather conditions were extreme during the storm.
example_zh: 暴風雨期間天氣狀況極為惡劣。

example_zh: 她直視著我的眼睛。

example_zh: 他驚訝地挑了挑眉。

example_zh: 她給長長的睫毛塗上了睫毛膏。

example: Her eyelids fluttered as she began to wake up.
example_zh: 她緩緩睜開眼，開始醒來。

example_zh: 據說吃胡蘿蔔對視力有好處。

example_zh: 伊索寓言透過簡單的故事講述道德教訓。

example: This sofa is covered in soft velvet fabric.
example_zh: 這款沙發採用柔軟的天鵝絨布料。

example_zh: 我們昨天在派對上玩得非常開心。

example: We must face the challenge with confidence.
example_zh: 我們必須充滿信心地面對挑戰。

example_zh: 聽到這個消息，她的表情變了。

example: Modern technology facilitates global communication.
example_zh: 現代科技促進了全球溝通。

example: The sports facility includes a swimming pool and a gym.
example_zh: 該體育設施包括游泳池和健身房。

example: It is a known fact that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
example_zh: 地球繞太陽公轉是眾所皆知的事實。

example: Rival factions within the party struggled for power.
example_zh: 黨內各派為爭奪權力而鬥爭。

example: Cost was a major factor in our decision.
example_zh: 成本是我們做決定時的重要因素。

example_zh: 他在電子工廠擔任經理。

example: She joined the university faculty as a professor.
example_zh: 她加入大學教職隊伍，擔任教授。

example: The color of the shirt began to fade after several washes.
example_zh: 襯衫洗了幾次之後顏色就開始褪色了。

example: Water freezes at 32 degrees Fahrenheit.
example_zh: 水的冰點是華氏32度。

example_zh: 跑完馬拉松後感到疲倦是正常的。

example: Many birds fly north during the spring.
example_zh: 春天，許多鳥類會飛往北方。

example: They moved to a small town in the northern part of the country.
example_zh: 他們搬到了該國北部的一個小鎮。

example: He wiped his nose with a tissue.
example_zh: 他用紙巾擦了擦鼻子。

example: Cold air rushed into his nostrils as he stepped outside.
example_zh: 他走出屋外，一股冷空氣湧入鼻腔。

example: She is not feeling well today, so she stayed home.
example_zh: 她今天身體不舒服，所以待在家裡。

example: There has been a notable improvement in his grades.
example_zh: 他的成績有了顯著提高。

example: Leave a note on the fridge if you go out.
example_zh: 如果你要出門，請在冰箱上留個便條。

example: I wrote down all the important lecture points in my notebook.
example_zh: 我把所有重要的講課要點都記在筆記本上了。

example: There is nothing left in the refrigerator.
example_zh: 冰箱裡什麼都沒有了。

example: Did you notice any changes in his behavior recently?
example_zh: 你最近有沒有註意到他的行為有什麼改變？

example: There was a noticeable difference in temperature between day and night.
example_zh: 晝夜溫差明顯。

example: Please notify us immediately if your phone number changes.
example_zh: 如果您的電話號碼發生變更，請立即通知我們。

example: I have no notion of what he is talking about.
example_zh: 我完全不知道他在說什麼。

example: The area is notorious for its heavy traffic jams.
example_zh: 該地區以交通擁堵嚴重而臭名昭著。

example: Healthy food provides nourishment for the growing body.
example_zh: 健康的食物為正在成長的身體提供營養。

example: She is currently writing her second historical novel.
example_zh: 她目前正在創作她的第二本歷史小說。

example: The famous novelist signed books for her fans.
example_zh: 這位著名小說家為她的粉絲簽名售書。

example: He is still a novice at playing chess.
example_zh: 他下棋還是個新手。

example: We need to leave right now or we will be late.
example_zh: 我們必須馬上出發，否則就要遲到了。

example: Nowadays, most people use smartphones to stay connected.
example_zh: 如今，大多數人使用智慧型手機來保持聯繫。

example: There was nowhere to hide from the sudden rainstorm.
example_zh: 突如其來的暴雨讓人無處可躲。

example: Nuclear power plants generate a large amount of electricity.
example_zh: 核電廠能產生大量的電力。

example: The nucleus contains most of the cell's genetic material.
example_zh: 細胞核包含細胞的大部分遺傳物質。

example: The museum exhibited a famous nude statue.
example_zh: 博物館展出了一尊著名的裸體雕像。

example: Can you give me your phone number?
example_zh: 你能把你的電話號碼給我嗎？

example: He has published numerous books on history.
example_zh: 他出版了許多歷史方面的書籍。

example: She decided to devote her life to God and became a nun.
example_zh: 她決定將自己的一生奉獻給上帝，成為了修女。

example: The nurse took my temperature and checked my blood pressure.
example_zh: 護士幫我量了體溫，量了血壓。

example: Parents can leave their kids at the nursery while they work.
example_zh: 父母可以在工作時將孩子送到托兒所。

example: Parents should nurture their children's interests and talents.
example_zh: 父母應該培養孩子的興趣和才能。

example: Squirrels like to gather nuts for the winter.
example_zh: 松鼠喜歡收集堅果過冬。

example: Vegetables are rich in essential vitamins and nutrients.
example_zh: 蔬菜富含人體必需的維生素和營養素。

example: Good nutrition is essential for a healthy body.
example_zh: 良好的營養對身體健康至關重要。

example: A nutritious breakfast helps start your day off right.
example_zh: 營養豐富的早餐能讓你一天有個好的開始。

example: Is it okay if I sit here?
example_zh: 我可以坐在這裡嗎？

example: The meeting starts at three o'clock sharp.
example_zh: 會議三點準時開始。

example: The old table was made of solid oak.
example_zh: 那張舊桌子是用實心橡木做的。

example: The traveler found a small oasis in the middle of the desert.
example_zh: 旅行者在沙漠中央發現了一小塊綠洲。

example: The president took an oath to uphold the law.
example_zh: 總統宣誓維護法律。

example: I usually have a bowl of hot oatmeal for breakfast.
example_zh: 我通常早餐吃一碗熱燕麥粥。

example: Dogs require training to learn basic obedience.
example_zh: 狗狗需要訓練才能學會基本的服從指令。

example: The obedient child always does what his parents ask.
example_zh: 聽話的孩子總是會做父母要求的事。

example: Drivers must obey traffic regulations at all times.
example_zh: 駕駛員必須始終遵守交通規則。

example: There was a strange unidentified object in the sky.
example_zh: 天空中出現了一個奇怪的不明物體。

example: Does anyone have any objection to the new proposal?
example_zh: 有人對這項新提案有異議嗎？

example: Our primary objective is to improve customer satisfaction.
example_zh: 我們的首要目標是提高客戶滿意度。

example: We have a moral obligation to help those in need.
example_zh: 我們有道義上的責任去幫助有需要的人。

example: The heavy rain obliged us to stay indoors all day.
example_zh: 由於暴雨，我們不得不整天待在室內。

example: The details of the ancient contract remain obscure.
example_zh: 這份古老契約的細節仍然不明。

example: She made an insightful observation during the seminar.
example_zh: 她在研討會上提出了一個很有見地的觀點。

example: Scientists carefully observe the behavior of animals.
example_zh: 科學家仔細觀察動物的行為。

example: International observers monitored the election closely.
example_zh: 國際觀察員密切關注了選舉過程。

example: Don't obsess over small details that don't matter.
example_zh: 不要糾結於無關緊要的小細節。

example: Fear of failure is a major obstacle to success.
example_zh: 害怕失敗是通往成功的主要障礙。

example: He refused to listen to advice because he was so obstinate.
example_zh: 他固執己見，拒絕聽取勸告。

example: You need to obtain permission before entering the facility.
example_zh: 進入該設施前需取得許可。

example: It was obvious that she was feeling nervous.
example_zh: 她顯然感到緊張。

example: A wedding is a celebration for a happy occasion.
example_zh: 婚禮是慶祝喜事的儀式。

example: He enjoys an occasional glass of wine with dinner.
example_zh: 他偶爾喜歡在晚餐時喝一杯葡萄酒。

example: Please state your name, age, and occupation on the form.
example_zh: 請在表格上填寫您的姓名、年齡和職業。

example: Work will occupy most of my time this week.
example_zh: 本周大部分時間都將用於工作。

example: Earthquakes can occur without any warning.
example_zh: 地震可能毫無預警地發生。

example: Power outages are a common occurrence during severe storms.
example_zh: 強風暴期間，停電是常見現象。

example: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
example_zh: 太平洋是地球上最大的海洋。

example: An octopus can change its color to blend in with its surroundings.
example_zh: 章魚可以改變顏色以融入周圍環境。

example: He had a very odd look on his face.
example_zh: 他臉上帶著一種非常奇怪的表情。

example: The odds of winning the lottery are extremely low.
example_zh: 中樂透的機率極低。

example: The strange odor in the room was caused by a gas leak.
example_zh: 房間裡的異味是由瓦斯洩漏引起的。

example: She is a member of the local book club.
example_zh: 她是當地讀書俱樂部的成員。

example: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
example_zh: 離開時請關燈。

example: I am sorry if my comments offended you.
example_zh: 如果我的言論冒犯了您，我深感抱歉。

example: Driving without a license is a serious offense.
example_zh: 無證駕駛是嚴重的違法行為。

example: His offensive remarks upset many people in the audience.
example_zh: 他的冒犯性言論激怒了現場許多觀眾。

example: They offered me a job with a good salary.
example_zh: 他們給我提供了一份薪水不錯的工作。

example: The museum's new exhibition is a impressive artistic offering.
example_zh: 博物館的新展覽是一場令人印象深刻的藝術盛宴。

example: She works in a tech company's head office.
example_zh: 她在一家科技公司的總部工作。

example: A police officer stopped the car for speeding.
example_zh: 一名警察因該車超速將其攔下。

example: The official language of Brazil is Portuguese.
example_zh: 巴西的官方語言是葡萄牙語。

example: They built an offshore wind farm to generate clean energy.
example_zh: 他們建造了一座離岸風力發電場來生產清潔能源。

example: Animals work hard to protect their offspring from predators.
example_zh: 動物們竭盡全力保護它們的後代免受捕食者的侵害。

example: How often do you go to the gym?
example_zh: 你多久去一次健身房？

example: Heat some olive oil in the pan before cooking.
example_zh: 烹調前先在鍋裡加熱一些橄欖油。

example: This historic castle is hundreds of years old.
example_zh: 這座歷史悠久的城堡已有數百年歷史。

example: She added fresh olives to the Greek salad.
example_zh: 她在希臘沙拉裡加入了新鮮橄欖。

example: You can omit unnecessary details from your summary.
example_zh: 您可以從摘要中省略不必要的細節。

example: The book is lying on the kitchen table.
example_zh: 這本書放在廚房的桌子上。

example: I go for a medical checkup once a year.
example_zh: 我每年都會做一次體檢。

example: Negotiations between the two companies are still ongoing.
example_zh: 兩家公司之間的談判仍在進行中。

example: Chop the onion finely before frying it.
example_zh: 炒之前先把洋蔥切碎。

example: Many people prefer to shop online for convenience.
example_zh: 許多人為了方便更喜歡網上購物。

example: This was the only available option left.
example_zh: 這是唯一剩下的選擇。

example: The cat jumped onto the kitchen counter.
example_zh: 貓跳上了廚房的檯面。

example: Please leave the window open to let fresh air in.
example_zh: 請打開窗戶，讓新鮮空氣進來。

example: We bought tickets to see a famous Italian opera.
example_zh: 我們買了票去看一場著名的義大利歌劇。

example: Do you know how to operate this machine?
example_zh: 你知道怎麼操作這台機器嗎？

example: The doctor performed a successful heart operation.
example_zh: 醫生成功地進行了心臟手術。

example: The new subway line will become operational next month.
example_zh: 新的地鐵線路將於下個月投入營運。

def: 生效的、操作的；工作人員
example: The new safety regulations become operative starting today.
example_zh: 新的安全法規從今天起生效。

example: The machine operator wore protective gear.
example_zh: 機器操作員穿戴了防護裝備。

example: Everyone has a right to express their own opinion.
example_zh: 每個人都有權利表達自己的觀點。

example: She defeated her opponent in the final match.
example_zh: 她在決賽中擊敗了對手。

example: Studying abroad is a great opportunity to learn about new cultures.
example_zh: 出國留學是了解新文化的絕佳機會。

example: Many citizens oppose the construction of the new highway.
example_zh: 許多市民反對興建這條新高速公路。

example: They live on the opposite side of the street.
example_zh: 他們住在街對面。

example: The proposed tax increase met with strong opposition.
example_zh: 這項增稅提案遭到了強烈反對。

example: The regime used violence to oppress its citizens.
example_zh: 政權使用暴力鎮壓其公民。

example: The people fought bravely against oppression and injustice.
example_zh: 人民英勇反抗壓迫和不公義。

example: He decided to opt for a career in law.
example_zh: 他決定從事法律行業。

example: Her optimism inspired everyone on the team during hard times.
example_zh: 在艱難時期，她的樂觀精神激勵了團隊中的每一個人。

example: We remain optimistic about the company's future growth.
example_zh: 我們對公司未來的發展前景依然保持樂觀。

example: You have the option to pay by cash or credit card.
example_zh: 您可以選擇現金支付或信用卡支付。

example: Attending the evening workshop is completely optional.
example_zh: 參加晚間研討會完全是自願的。

example: Would you like tea or coffee?
example_zh: 您想喝茶還是咖啡？

example: Students have to pass both a written test and an oral exam.
example_zh: 學生必須通過筆試和口試。

example: She drank a glass of fresh orange juice.
example_zh: 她喝了一杯鮮榨柳橙汁。

example: The Earth moves in an orbit around the Sun.
example_zh: 地球繞著太陽做公轉運動。

example: They picked fresh apples from the orchard.
example_zh: 他們從果園裡摘了新鮮的蘋果。

example: The orchestra played a beautiful symphony by Beethoven.
example_zh: 樂團演奏了貝多芬一首優美的交響曲。

example: Surviving the shipwreck was a terrible ordeal.
example_zh: 從沉船事故中倖存下來是一場可怕的磨難。

example: Please put the files in alphabetical order.
example_zh: 請按字母順序排列文件。

example: The crowd queued up in an orderly manner.
example_zh: 人群有秩序地排起了長隊。

example: It was just an ordinary day until the surprise news arrived.
example_zh: 原本只是平凡的一天，直到傳來令人震驚的消息。

example: The heart is a vital organ in the human body.
example_zh: 心臟是人體的重要器官。

example: Organic food is grown without artificial pesticides.
example_zh: 有機食品的種植過程中不使用人工農藥。

example: Microscopic organisms live in almost every environment on Earth.
example_zh: 地球上幾乎所有環境都生活著微生物。

example: She works for an international organization.
example_zh: 她在國際組織工作。

example: We need to organize a meeting for next week.
example_zh: 我們需要安排下週開會。

example: The organizer of the event did a great job.
example_zh: 活動主辦單位做得非常出色。

example: It took him a while to orient himself in the new city.
example_zh: 他花了一段時間才適應這座新城市。

example: The museum has a rich collection of Oriental art.
example_zh: 博物館擁有豐富的東方藝術藏品。

example: The university holds an orientation program for new students.
example_zh: 大學會為新生舉辦入學指導活動。

example: The origin of this custom is unknown.
example_zh: 這種習俗的起源尚不清楚。

example: This is the original copy of the contract.
example_zh: 這是合約原件。

example: Her artwork shows great originality.
example_zh: 她的作品展現了極強的原創性。

example: The story originated in ancient Greece.
example_zh: 這個故事起源於古希臘。

example: They decorated the tree with colorful ornaments.
example_zh: 他們用色彩繽紛的裝飾品裝點了這棵樹。

example: The boy became an orphan at a young age.
example_zh: 男孩年幼時就成了孤兒。

example: She volunteered at a local orphanage.
example_zh: 她在當地一家孤兒院做義工。

example: He holds orthodox views on religion.
example_zh: 他對宗教持有正統觀點。

example: Do you have any other questions?
example_zh: 您還有其他問題嗎？

example: Run, otherwise you will miss the train.
example_zh: 快跑，不然會錯過火車。

example: An ounce is equal to about 28 grams.
example_zh: 一盎司約等於28公克。

example: She opened the window and looked out.
example_zh: 她打開窗戶，向外望去。

example: The outbreak of the flu affected many people.
example_zh: 流感爆發影響了很多人。

example: We are waiting for the final outcome of the election.
example_zh: 我們正在等待選舉的最終結果。

example: They enjoy outdoor activities like hiking.
example_zh: 他們喜歡健行等戶外活動。

example: Kids love playing outdoors on sunny days.
example_zh: 在陽光明媚的日子裡，孩子們喜歡在戶外玩耍。

example: The outer layer of the onion was dry.
example_zh: 洋蔥外層乾枯了。

example: She wore a stylish outfit to the party.
example_zh: 她穿著一身時髦的衣服去參加派對。

example: He is an outgoing person who makes friends easily.
example_zh: 他個性外向，很容易交朋友。

example: The company organized a weekend outing for its employees.
example_zh: 公司為員工組織了一次週末郊遊。

example: The government decided to outlaw smoking in public parks.
example_zh: 政府決定禁止在公共公園吸煙。

example: Plug the cable into the electrical outlet.
example_zh: 將電纜插入電源插座。

example: He drew an outline of the project proposal.
example_zh: 他繪製了專案提案的概要。

example: She has a positive outlook on life.
example_zh: 她對生活抱持著積極樂觀的態度。

example: Female students outnumber male students in this department.
example_zh: 該系女生人數多於男生。

example: The factory increased its daily output.
example_zh: 工廠提高了日產量。

example: The new policy caused public outrage.
example_zh: 新政策引發了公眾強烈的憤慨。

def: 令人不能容忍的、荒謬的
example: The prices at that restaurant are outrageous.
example_zh: 那家餐廳的價格簡直離譜。

example: He rejected the proposal outright.
example_zh: 他斷然拒絕了這項提議。

example: From the outset, we knew this project would be difficult.
example_zh: 從一開始我們就知道這個專案會很困難。

example: Wait outside until your name is called.
example_zh: 在外面等候，直到叫到你的名字。

example: As an outsider, she found it hard to fit in.
example_zh: 身為外來者，她發現自己很難融入其中。

example: They live on the outskirts of the city.
example_zh: 他們住在城市郊區。

example: She received an award for her outstanding performance.
example_zh: 她因出色的表現而獲獎。

example: The door opens in an outward direction.
example_zh: 門向外打開。

example: The branches spread outwards.
example_zh: 樹枝向外伸展。

example: The dining table has an oval shape.
example_zh: 餐桌是橢圓形的。

example: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
example_zh: 將烤箱預熱至180度。

example: The cat jumped over the fence.
example_zh: 貓跳過了柵欄。

example: Overall, the results of the test were positive.
example_zh: 總體而言，測試結果呈陽性。

example: Put on your overcoat because it is freezing outside.
example_zh: 外面很冷，穿上外套吧。

example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of public speaking.
example_zh: 她努力克服了對公開演講的恐懼。

example: Don't overdo the exercise if you feel tired.
example_zh: 如果感到疲倦，就不要過度運動。

example: The water in the bathtub began to overflow.
example_zh: 浴缸裡的水開始溢出來了。

example: Planes flew overhead throughout the afternoon.
example_zh: 整個下午都有飛機從頭頂飛過。

example: I happened to overhear their conversation in the hallway.
example_zh: 我在走廊上偶然聽到了他們的對話。

example: The two events overlap, so I can only attend one.
example_zh: 這兩個活動時間衝突，所以我只能參加其中一個。

example: The hotel room overlooks the ocean.
example_zh: 飯店房間可以俯瞰大海。

example: You can stay overnight at my place.
example_zh: 你可以來我家過夜。

example: Many students dream of studying overseas.
example_zh: 許多學生夢想出國留學。

example: A manager was hired to oversee the project.
example_zh: 我們聘請了一位經理來負責監督這個專案。

example: It is dangerous to overtake on a narrow road.
example_zh: 在狹窄的道路上超車很危險。

example: The rebels attempted to overthrow the government.
example_zh: 叛軍企圖推翻政府。

example: The truck overturned on the highway.
example_zh: 卡車在高速公路上翻車了。

example: The team was overwhelmed by the sudden support.
example_zh: 團隊對突如其來的支持感到無比激動。

example: He fell ill because of overwork.
example_zh: 他因過度勞累而生病。

example: I owe you ten dollars for lunch.
example_zh: 我欠你十美元午餐費。

example: Owls are nocturnal birds of prey.
example_zh: 貓頭鷹是夜行性猛禽。

example: She owns a small bookstore in the town.
example_zh: 她在鎮上擁有一家小書店。

example: Who is the owner of this car?
example_zh: 這輛車的車主是誰？

example: The company changed ownership last month.
example_zh: 該公司上個月更換了所有者。

example: The farmer used an ox to plow the field.
example_zh: 農夫用牛耕地。

example_zh: 我們團隊每週一上午都會召開例會。

example: She wept tears of happiness when she heard the good news.
example_zh: 聽到這個好消息，她喜極而泣。

example: Please weigh your luggage before going to the airport.
example_zh: 請在前往機場前稱量行李重量。

example: Regular exercise can help you control your body weight.
example_zh: 規律運動有助於控制體重。

example: I heard a weird noise coming from the attic.
example_zh: 我聽到閣樓傳來奇怪的聲音。

example: Welcome to our home; please make yourself comfortable.
example_zh: 歡迎來到我家，請隨意坐。

example: The government aims to improve social welfare for low-income families.
example_zh: 政府的目標是改善低收入家庭的社會福利。

example: She speaks Fluent English and plays the piano very well.
example_zh: 她英語說得很流利，鋼琴彈得很好。

example: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
example_zh: 太陽從東方升起，從西方落下。

example: She enjoys reading Western literature and philosophy.
example_zh: 她喜歡閱讀西方文學和哲學。

example: Be careful walking outside; the pavement is wet.
example_zh: 外出行走時請小心，路面濕滑。

example: The blue whale is the largest living animal on Earth.
example_zh: 藍鯨是地球上現存體型最大的動物。

example: Fishermen unloaded fresh seafood at the wharf.
example_zh: 漁民在碼頭卸下新鮮海鮮。

example: What is your favorite type of music?
example_zh: 你最喜歡哪種類型的音樂？

example: You can order whatever you want from the menu.
example_zh: 您可以隨意點菜單上的任何菜餚。

def: 絲毫、任何（用於否定強調）
example: He had no interest whatsoever in playing football.
example_zh: 他對踢足球一點興趣都沒有。

example: Flour made from wheat is used to bake bread.
example_zh: 小麥製成的麵粉用於烘焙麵包。

example: One of the bicycle's wheels was damaged in the accident.
example_zh: 事故中，自行車的一個車輪受損。

example: The building has ramps designed for people in wheelchairs.
example_zh: 建築物設有專為輪椅使用者設計的坡道。

example: Call me when you arrive safely at the station.
example_zh: 安全到達車站後打電話給我。

example: Whenever I feel stressed, I listen to classical music.
example_zh: 每當我感到壓力時，我就會聽古典音樂。

example: Where did you put the house keys?
example_zh: 你把家門鑰匙放在哪裡了？

example: The police are asking the public for information about his whereabouts.
example_zh: 警方正在向公眾徵集有關他下落的資訊。

example: He loves sports, whereas his brother prefers quiet reading.
example_zh: 他熱愛運動，而他的兄弟則更喜歡安靜地閱讀。

example: I will support you wherever life takes you.
example_zh: 無論你未來的道路通往何方，我都會支持你。

example: I am not sure whether it will rain this afternoon.
example_zh: 我不確定今天下午會不會下雨。

example: Which option do you prefer?
example_zh: 你比較傾向於哪種方案？

example: She read a book while waiting for the train.
example_zh: 她在等火車的時候看了一本書。

example: The child began to whine about being tired.
example_zh: 孩子開始抱怨自己累了。

example: He whipped the cream until it was stiff.
example_zh: 他將奶油打發至硬挺。

example: He poured himself a glass of whiskey.
example_zh: 他給自己倒了一杯威士忌。

example: She whispered a secret in my ear.
example_zh: 她悄悄地在我耳邊說了一個秘密。

example: The referee blew his whistle to end the game.
example_zh: 裁判吹哨聲，比賽結束。

example: She wore an elegant white dress.
example_zh: 她穿著一件優雅的白色連身裙。

example: Who left the door open?
example_zh: 誰忘了關門？

example: Whoever finishes first will win a prize.
example_zh: 第一名將可獲得獎品。

example: I ate the whole pizza by myself.
example_zh: 我一個人吃完了整個披薩。

example: They buy their goods at wholesale prices.
example_zh: 他們以批發價進貨。

def: 有益健康的、合乎衛生的
example: Fresh air and healthy food are wholesome for children.
example_zh: 新鮮空氣和健康食品對孩子有益。

example: To whom should I address this letter?
example_zh: 這封信該寄給誰？

example: Whose car is parked outside?
example_zh: 外面停著誰的車？

example: Why did you change your mind?
example_zh: 為什麼你改變主意了？

example: The wicked witch cast a spell on the prince.
example_zh: 邪惡的女巫對王子施了魔法。

example: The river is very wide at this point.
example_zh: 此處河面非常寬闊。

example: They are planning to widen the main road.
example_zh: 他們計劃拓寬主幹道。

example: The news caused widespread concern.
example_zh: 該消息引起了廣泛關注。

example: She became a widow after her husband passed away.
example_zh: 丈夫過世後，她成了寡婦。

example: Please measure the length and width of the room.
example_zh: 請測量房間的長度和寬度。

example: He bought flowers for his wife.
example_zh: 他買了花給妻子。

example: She wore a blonde wig to the party.
example_zh: 她戴著一頂金色假髮參加了派對。

example: Lions are wild animals.
example_zh: 獅子是野生動物。

example: They went hiking in the wilderness.
example_zh: 他們去野外健行。

example: The park protects local wildlife.
example_zh: 公園保護當地野生動物。

example: Where there is a will, there is a way.
example_zh: 有志者事竟成。

example: Are you willing to help us with this project?
example_zh: 您願意協助我們完成這個專案嗎？

example: Our team won the championship.
example_zh: 我們隊贏得了冠軍。

example: Strong winds blew down several trees.
example_zh: 強風吹倒了幾棵樹。

example: Please open the window to let fresh air in.
example_zh: 請打開窗戶，讓新鮮空氣進來。

example: A stone hit and cracked the car's windshield.
example_zh: 一塊石頭擊中了汽車擋風玻璃，將其擊裂。

example: It is too windy to go for a boat ride today.
example_zh: 今天風太大，不適合乘船遊覽。

example: They enjoyed a glass of red wine with dinner.
example_zh: 他們晚餐時喝了一杯紅酒。

example: The bird hurt its left wing.
example_zh: 這隻鳥的左翼受傷了。

example: He winked at me to show he was joking.
example_zh: 他朝我眨了眨眼，表示他是在開玩笑。

example: Please wipe your shoes before entering.
example_zh: 請進前擦拭鞋底。

example: Be careful not to touch that live wire.
example_zh: 小心別碰到那根帶電的電線。

example: With age comes wisdom.
example_zh: 隨著年齡增長，智慧也隨之而來。

example: It was a wise decision to save money.
example_zh: 省錢是個明智的決定。

example: I wish you a happy birthday.
example_zh: 祝你生日快樂。

example: He is famous for his sharp wit.
example_zh: 他以機智幽默而聞名。

example: The wizard cast a powerful spell.
example_zh: 巫師施放了一個威力強大的咒語。

example: She walked home with her friends.
example_zh: 她和朋友們一起走回家。

example: I need to withdraw some money from the bank.
example_zh: 我需要從銀行拿一些錢。

example: The flowers began to wither without water.
example_zh: 花朵因缺水而開始枯萎。

example: The police withheld the details of the investigation.
example_zh: 警方隱瞞了調查細節。

example: The task must be completed within two days.
example_zh: 這項任務必須在兩天內完成。

example: I cannot live without music.
example_zh: 我離不開音樂。

example: Police are looking for witnesses to the accident.
example_zh: 警方正在尋找事故目擊者。

example: She made a witty remark that entertained everyone.
example_zh: 她說了句妙語，逗得大家都哈哈大笑。

example: She shared her tales of woe with her friend.
example_zh: 她向朋友傾訴了自己的悲慘遭遇。

example: The wolf howled at the moon.
example_zh: 狼對著月亮嚎叫。

example: She is a very successful woman.
example_zh: 她是一位非常成功的女性。

example: I wonder why he didn't show up.
example_zh: 我很好奇他為什麼沒來。

example: We had a wonderful time at the party.
example_zh: 我們在派對上玩得很開心。

example: They took a long walk in the woods.
example_zh: 他們在樹林裡走了很長一段路。

example: They sat on a simple wooden bench.
example_zh: 他們坐在一個簡易的木凳上。

example: A woodpecker was pecking at the tree trunk.
example_zh: 一隻啄木鳥正在啄樹幹。

example: This sweater is made of pure wool.
example_zh: 這件毛衣由純羊毛製成。

example: How do you spell this word?
example_zh: 這個詞怎麼拼？

example: Hard work leads to success.
example_zh: 努力工作才能獲得成功。

example: Complete page ten in your workbook.
example_zh: 請完成練習冊第十頁。

example: Factory workers are demanding better conditions.
example_zh: 工廠工人要求改善工作條件。

example: Women make up a large portion of the workforce.
example_zh: 女性在勞動力中佔很大比例。

example: I do a 30-minute workout every morning.
example_zh: 我每天早上都會​​進行30分鐘的運動。

example: Safety is very important in the workplace.
example_zh: 工作場所的安全至關重要。

example: She attended a photography workshop last weekend.
example_zh: 她上週末參加了一個攝影工作坊。

example: Travel allows you to see the world.
example_zh: 旅行讓你有機會看看世界。

example: The bird caught a worm in the garden.
example_zh: 這隻鳥在花園裡抓了一條蟲。

example: Don't worry, everything will be fine.
example_zh: 別擔心，一切都會好起來的。

example: The weather today is worse than yesterday.
example_zh: 今天的天氣比昨天更糟。

example: People gather here to worship.
example_zh: 人們聚集在這裡進行禮拜。

example: That was the worst movie I have ever seen.
example_zh: 那是我看過的最爛的電影。

example: This painting is worth a lot of money.
example_zh: 這幅畫價值連城。

example: Teaching is a challenging but worthwhile job.
example_zh: 教師這份工作充滿挑戰，但也非常有意義。

example: Her efforts are worthy of praise.
example_zh: 她的努力值得稱讚。

example: The doctor treated the patient's leg wound.
example_zh: 醫生處理了病人的腿部傷口。

example: Wrap the gift with pretty paper.
example_zh: 用漂亮的包裝紙把禮物包起來。

example: The car was a total wreck after the accident.
example_zh: 事故發生後，這輛車完全報廢了。

example: The two brothers love to wrestle on the lawn.
example_zh: 兩兄弟喜歡在草坪上摔角。

example: She has fine wrinkles around her eyes.
example_zh: 她眼周有細紋。

example: She wore a silver bracelet on her wrist.
example_zh: 她手腕上戴著一條銀手鍊。

example: Please write your name on the paper.
example_zh: 請在紙上寫下你的名字。

example: He dreams of becoming a famous writer.
example_zh: 他夢想成為一名著名作家。

example: I got the wrong answer to the question.
example_zh: 我答錯了這個問題。

example: They sailed around the island on a luxury yacht.
example_zh: 他們乘坐豪華遊艇環島遊覽。

example: Roasted yams are a popular winter snack.
example_zh: 烤山藥是冬季很受歡迎的點心。

example: The kids are playing in the back yard.
example_zh: 孩子們正在後院玩耍。

example: He could not stop yawning during the meeting.
example_zh: 會議期間他一直不停地打哈欠。

example: We moved to this city three years ago.
example_zh: 我們三年前搬到了這座城市。

example: The company holds a yearly conference.
example_zh: 公司每年都會舉辦一次年會。

example: She yearned to return to her hometown.
example_zh: 她渴望回到家鄉。

example: Don't yell at me, I can hear you fine.
example_zh: 別對我大吼大叫，我聽得很清楚。

example: Sunflowers are bright yellow.
example_zh: 向日葵是亮黃色的。

example: Yes, I would love to join you.
example_zh: 是的，我非常樂意加入你們。

example: I saw him at the supermarket yesterday.
example_zh: 我昨天在超市看到他了。

example: He hasn't arrived yet.
example_zh: 他還沒到。

example: The farm yields a large crop every year.
example_zh: 這個農場每年都大豐收。

example: She practices yoga every morning to relax.
example_zh: 她每天早上都會​​練習瑜珈來放鬆身心。

example: I usually eat yogurt with honey for breakfast.
example_zh: 我通常早餐吃蜂蜜優格。

example: She separated the egg white from the yolk.
example_zh: 她將蛋白和蛋黃分開了。

def: 你、你們（你的、你的東西、你自己、你們自己）
example: You should take good care of yourself.
example_zh: 你應該好好照顧自己。

example: The young girl dreams of becoming a doctor.
example_zh: 這個小女孩夢想成為一名醫生。

example: The park was filled with youngsters playing soccer.
example_zh: 公園裡到處都是踢足球的年輕人。

example: He spent his youth traveling around the world.
example_zh: 他年輕時週遊世界。

def: 富有青春活力的、年輕的
example: She maintains a youthful appearance through regular exercise.
example_zh: 她透過定期運動保持青春容顏。

example: We saw a herd of zebras during the safari.
example_zh: 我們在遊獵途中看到了一群斑馬。

example: The temperature dropped below zero last night.
example_zh: 昨晚氣溫降至零度以下。

example: The zipper on my jacket is stuck.
example_zh: 我的外套拉鍊卡住了。

example: Parking is not allowed in this loading zone.
example_zh: 此裝卸區禁止停車。

example: The kids were excited to see the pandas at the zoo.
example_zh: 孩子們很高興能在動物園看到熊貓。

example: The sports car zoomed past us on the highway.
example_zh: 那輛跑車在高速公路上飛馳而過。

example: The statement turned out to be false.
example_zh: 事實證明，該說法不實。

example: Is it true that you are changing jobs next month?
example_zh: 聽說你下個月要換工作，是真的嗎？
